hooks.command: R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)||exit 0;cd "$R"||exit 0;[ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]||exit 0;B=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD);git add -A;git commit -q -m "auto: session checkpoint $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"||exit 0;n=0;until git push -q origin "$B";do n=$((n+1));[ $n -ge 4 ]&&break;sleep $((2*n));done;exit 0
